documents.no_download_url: Clio did not return a download URL.
documents.download_unauthorized: 401 Unauthorized while downloading – the token is not valid.
documents.upload_name_required: A file name is required when uploading from memory.
documents.matter_no_root_folder: Matter {matter_id} has no root document folder.
documents.internal_template_not_configur: No internal template configured (CLIO_INTERNAL_TEMPLATE). Pass template_id/template explicitly. Available: {list}
documents.user_letterhead_not_found: Letterhead "{template}" configured for {email} was not found in Clio. Available: {list}
documents.default_template_not_found: Default template "{template}" not found in Clio. Available: {list}
documents.no_letterhead_configured: No letterhead configured for {email}. Pass template_id or template (name/prefix), or configure CLIO_LETTERHEADS / CLIO_DEFAULT_TEMPLATE in the extension settings. Available templates: {list}
documents.search_need_filter: Provide at least one of matter_id, parent_id, contact_id or query.
documents.read_image_note: Image – read the text from the image.
documents.read_cannot_render_images: Format {ext} cannot be converted to page images.
documents.read_pages_as_images_note: Pages returned as images – read the text from the images; further pages via page_from/page_to.
documents.read_scanned_pdf_note: The PDF has no text layer (scan) – pages returned as images; read the text from them.
documents.read_pdf_images_hint: If the text looks incomplete (stamps, handwritten parts, tables), call again with mode='images'.
documents.download_hint: After editing, upload it back: clio_document_upload_version {document_id, file_path}
documents.claude_folder_default: the "{folder}" folder in the matter (created if missing)
documents.without_letterhead_note: No letterhead. Create the file and upload it with clio_document_upload.
documents.preview_letterhead_document: New document from letterhead → matter {matter}, folder "{folder}"
documents.created_next_step: The document is in Clio; for changes use clio_document_write (new version from text) or download and edit it in Cowork.
documents.download_template_next_step: Fill in the content and upload the file: clio_document_upload {file_path: "{path}", matter_id: {matter_id}, confirm: true} – it will be stored in the "{folder}" folder of the matter.
documents.preview_automation: Document Automation – generate a document in the matter
documents.automation_pending_next_step: Generation is still running; check clio_api_request GET /document_automations/{automation_id}
documents.write_not_docx: Document {name} is not a DOCX – a new version from text is not possible.
documents.preview_write_version: New version of document {document_id} ({name}) from text
documents.content_empty: No document was created: the content is empty or too short. Ask the user what the document should contain (type, addressee, text) and call the tool again with the full text in content. For a blank letterhead on disk use mode='download'.
